facts.summary: A beneficiary may be able to update the address associated with their PDS or ration-card record through the applicable State or Union Territory process.
purpose: Keep the beneficiary address information accurate.
Maintain correct household or ration-card records.
Support PDS services that depend on beneficiary address information.
how_to_update: Use the official PDS portal if the State/UT provides an online address-update facility.
Visit the designated Food and Civil Supplies or PDS office if an offline update is required.
Submit the required information and documents according to the applicable State/UT procedure.
Complete any verification required by the concerned authority.
facts.verification: The concerned State/UT may require identity, ration-card, residence or other verification before updating the address.
requirements: Existing beneficiary or ration-card information may be required.
Proof of the new address may be required according to State/UT rules.
Additional documents may be required depending on the applicable procedure.
facts.online_update: Online address-update availability depends on the concerned State or Union Territory PDS system.
failed_update: Check that the submitted information and documents are correct.
If online updating is unavailable or unsuccessful, follow the designated offline procedure or contact the concerned PDS authority.
facts.state_specific: The available online service, required documents, verification process and address-update procedure can differ between States and Union Territories.
facts.privacy: Beneficiary information and address documents should only be submitted through official government portals, offices or authorized PDS facilities.
important_notes: Do not assume that every State/UT provides online address updates.
Do not invent a specific document list without State/UT-specific information.
An address update may involve verification by the concerned authority.
Changing an address is different from changing a registered mobile number.

faqs.question: How can I change the address on my ration card?
faqs.answer: Follow the address-update process provided by your State/UT PDS authority, either through its official portal where available or through the designated PDS/Food and Civil Supplies office.

faqs.question: Can I update my ration card address online?
faqs.answer: Online address-update availability depends on the concerned State or Union Territory PDS system.

faqs.question: What documents are required to change my ration card address?
faqs.answer: The required documents depend on the applicable State/UT procedure and may include proof of the new address and beneficiary or ration-card information.

faqs.question: Do I need verification to change my address?
faqs.answer: The concerned State/UT may require identity, ration-card, residence or other verification before changing the address.

faqs.question: What should I do if I cannot update my address online?
faqs.answer: If the online facility is unavailable or unsuccessful, follow the designated offline procedure or contact the concerned State/UT PDS or Food and Civil Supplies authority.

organizations: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
Concerned State or Union Territory Food and Civil Supplies Authority
